title: Kanbo
summary: Team project board with drag-and-drop cards, checklists, comments and my work.
description: A project board for a small team: columns with draggable cards, a card sheet with checklist and comments, and a My work view per person. A rule enforces a work-in-progress limit, the board updates live, assignees are notified and a daily job flags overdue cards.
roles_summary: Managers and members, invited by the team.
includes: Board with columns and draggable cards
Card sheet with checklist and comments
